# Romanian (`ro`)

**Base patterns:** 4. Time-of-day and trailing-text variants are generated at `DateParser` construction. See the [language overview](/languages/) for flags and format codes.

| Pattern Key | Name | Format | Min Length | Max Length | Year Short | No Year | Filter | Examples |
|-------------|------|--------|------------|------------|------------|---------|--------|----------|
| `dt:date:ro_base` | Romanian date with title-case month name | `%d %m %Y` | 10 | 18 |  |  | 1 | `15 Martie 2024`, `3 Decembrie 2023`, `28 Iulie 2025` |
| `dt:date:ro_base_lc` | Romanian date with lowercase month name | `%d %m %Y` | 10 | 18 |  |  | 1 | `15 martie 2024`, `3 decembrie 2023`, `28 iulie 2025` |
| `dt:date:ro_short` | Romanian date with abbreviated title-case month | `%d %m %Y` | 10 | 13 |  |  | 1 | `15 Mar. 2024`, `3 Dec. 2023`, `28 Iul. 2025` |
| `dt:date:ro_short_lc` | Romanian date with abbreviated lowercase month | `%d %m %Y` | 10 | 13 |  |  | 1 | `15 mar. 2024`, `3 dec. 2023`, `28 iul. 2025` |

See also: [languages=](/api/languages), [adding languages](/development/adding-languages).
